liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, and borrowings due within two years stood at {{borrowings_due_2y@FY2024}}, so the near-term maturities are covered by cash on hand without new funding.
Free cash flow after lease payments was {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, or {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}.

Customer prepayments rose, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}} and advance ticket cover at {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, so a larger share of the cash balance is customers' money.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow after lease payments was {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, or {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, so cash flow did not cover capital spending and lease payments.

Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, the weakest of the network peers against a median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Maturities: debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, against cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2024}} that fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2024}}, which raises the sensitivity of the cash balance to bookings.
